claim_extraction.claim_text_span: We received only 80 of the 100 units invoiced on INV-002. Please issue a credit note for 20 units.

match_reasons: Invoice ID matches buyer dispute claim explicitly.
Shipment reference SHP-002 links directly to invoice INV-002.

findings.statement: Line-item invoice arithmetic is mathematically verified (100 pcs × ₹150 = ₹15,000).
assumptions: Pre-tax and pre-discount line computation as recorded.
limitations: Does not constitute full tax or ledger reconciliation.

findings.statement: Recorded delivery shortage of 20 pcs between invoice INV-REC-002 (100 pcs) and signed receipt POD-REC-002 (80 pcs).
assumptions: Both records relate to the same shipment SHP-002 and item ITEM-01.
limitations: Other deliveries or back-orders may exist outside supplied records.
findings.next_step: Verify whether the receipt covers the complete shipment or request a credit note for 20 pcs.

findings.statement: No credit note found in supplied dataset for the ₹3,000 difference (20 pcs shortage).
limitations: Absence in dataset does not prove a credit note was never created in external systems.
findings.next_step: Contact supplier accounts to verify if credit note was issued outside current records.

findings.statement: Recorded payment of ₹12,000 leaves ₹3,000 balance; cause of deduction is unconfirmed in payment remarks.
assumptions: Payment is tentatively linked to invoice INV-002 based on customer account reference.
limitations: Bank reference does not explicitly state that the ₹3,000 deduction is for delivery shortage.
findings.next_step: Obtain payment advice or debit note from buyer to verify reason for ₹3,000 deduction.

unresolved_questions: Does signed receipt POD-REC-002 cover the full delivery or was there a second split dispatch?
Was an unlinked credit note issued under a different invoice reference?
